title: ProofStep
description: A single step in a tactic proof, recording the goal state transition caused by one tactic application. ProofStep[] forms a tree: each step's children are the sub-proofs for each subgoal it produces.

id.description: Unique identifier for this step within the proof (e.g. sequential index or MVarId)

tactic.description: The tactic label that produced this step (e.g. 'intro', 'exact', 'simp', 'apply')

hyps.description: Hypotheses in scope before this tactic was applied

type.description: Hypothesis type as a pretty-printed string

goal.description: The goal formula before this tactic was applied, as a pretty-printed string

subgoals.description: Goal formulas remaining after this tactic was applied. Empty = proof complete at this branch.

children.description: Sub-proof trees for each subgoal. children[i] discharges subgoals[i].

pos.description: Source position of this tactic in the original file (optional)
